usedFor: Stripe processes your payments, and Webengage gets each buyer as a user through “Add User”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe, then “Add User” in Webengage
bestTemplate.why: Each paying customer is added to Webengage, ready for engagement messages.

watchOut: “When a checkout session is completed” also fires for one purchase, so using both adds the user twice.
